message: 연도별 1 km ALT 지도 시리즈(알래스카)와 그 지역 평균의 연도 편차가 관측 셀 평균을 따르는지, 제품 학습 지점 밖 공통 셀에서 최선 제품 대비 정확도, 적용 범위·구간 폭

a.content: Alaska ALT 2011–2024, 2 × 7 small multiples, same colour range (MV.pct_range over all years, oslo_r), year label top-left, observed cells of that year (black dots), outside-AOA cells faded, shared horizontal colorbar 'ALT (cm)', 200 km scale bar on 2011, graticule labels on left column and bottom row
a.render: cells binned to a 0.045° × 0.02° lon/lat raster (mean r1, mean aoa_in), imshow in PlateCarree with aspect 1/cos(65°); Natural Earth 50m land/coastline (cartopy shapereader)

b.content: regional mean predicted ALT anomaly per year (line, all mapped cells, vs 2011–2024 mean) for Alaska and Lena Delta; open circles = observed cell means for years with ≥ 50 cell-years
b.observed_definition: per cell-year (observed − mapped 2011–2024 mean at the nearest cell, ≤ 1.5 km), averaged per year, then centred to the predicted anomaly mean over the same years (removes site composition and the observation-day offset); must be stated in the caption

c.content: RMSE on common cells beyond 25 km from product training sites: physics + residual ML (R1 (CatBoost)) vs best published product (min RMSE over Wei 2026, Liu 2024, ESA CCI v4) per region; horizontal bars, method/product colours, values not printed

d.content: share of mapped cells inside the area of applicability (%) and 90 % prediction-interval half-width (cm), Alaska and Lena Delta, region colours
